Agassi introduced his signature paddle collection, while Graf joined the partnership in January 2025 with her own signature paddle. Beyond equipment, the venture also supports community outreach, with JOOLA donating a paddle for every Agassi collection paddle sold through its website. Their partnership combines sports innovation, business opportunities and efforts to make pickleball more accessible.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' $325 million KC Current opens new doors for 120 children with free soccer league
articles.description: The Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in July to help children overcome financial barriers to sports. The program provides 120 players aged 8 to 10 with uniforms, Nike cleats and equipment at no cost. Supported by community partners, the initiative also offers coach stipends and referee training for teenagers. The league aims to expand access, support local families and encourage greater participation, particularly among girls.
